about_the_game:
This is a two-player-exclusive horror game where you work together to find "anomalies."

Note: Communication between players is required to play this game. If you are not playing in person, an environment where players can use voice chat is necessary. Please note that a voice chat function is not implemented within the game. Please keep this in mind when purchasing.

【Game Description】

Players form a pair and explore a dimly lit map. At first glance, it may seem like you are walking through the same map, but there is exactly one thing that appears different in each player's field of vision. That is the "Anomaly." By communicating these differences through conversation and having both players stare at the anomaly simultaneously for a certain amount of time, the anomaly will be resolved, and you will loop back to your starting position. The goal of the game is to find many anomalies by repeating this process.

【Game Features】

  • Two-Player Cooperative Play

"Mitsume" is a two-player-exclusive horror game played using two devices. To play this game, you need a partner to play with. You cannot play this game alone or against a computer (CPU). Two human players are strictly required. You will proceed with your exploration while sharing the differences in what you see. Mutual observation skills and conversation are the keys to progress.

  • Anomaly Hunting and Loop Structure

Once both players discover an anomaly lurking somewhere in the map and "stare" at it simultaneously, the anomaly is resolved, and the players loop back to where they started. If you fail to find it within the time limit, an unstoppable monster will appear, resulting in a Game Over.

  • The Terrifying Presence:"Mitsume"

A "mysterious third person" wanders the map. This "mysterious third person" may transform into the three-eyed monster "Mitsume" and attack the players. You can repel it by cooperating to stare at it together, but if you are caught twice, it is Game Over.

【Controls】

Movement: WASD keys

Camera: Mouse movement

Stare: Hold Right-Click

Open/Close Doors: Left-Click

Menu: Esc key

【Game Information】

Players: 2 Players only (Co-op exclusive)

Genre: Cooperative Horror / Exploration / Walking Simulator

Playtime: Approx. 20–40 minutes per playthrough

Supported Languages: Japanese

【Video Posting Guidelines】

This game allows for video posting and live streaming by both individuals and corporations without the need for prior permission or contact. However, please adhere to the following guidelines:

  • Posts or live streams containing content that offends public order and morals, or significantly damages the value or world of the game, are prohibited.

  • Please include the name of the game in the title of your video or live stream.

  • Please include the URL of the Store Page in the summary or description section of your video or live stream.

  • Monetization is only permitted when using features provided by video hosting sites, such as the "YouTube Partner Program."

  • 382 PROJECT shall not be held liable for any damages incurred by the uploader or any third party in connection with video postings or live streams.

These guidelines are subject to change without notice. Please ensure you check the latest guidelines before posting. (Updated: 2026/02/10)

short_description: "Mitsume" is a two-player cooperative horror game. Wander together through a dimly lit university campus and communicate to find "anomalies" that appear from only one player's perspective.
